entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MAUI iOS does not rebuild correctly on XAML changes #30732
  • [Android] Image randomly disappears while switching tabs due to a race condition #30728
  • VB2022 publish application Add/Remove Icon not the same application icon #30726

Closed

  • TabbedPage Unloaded Event Not Triggered on Page Switch #30627

PullRequests

Created

  • [iOS] Permissions.RequestAsync<Permissions.Sensors> does not return a value on iOS16+ - fix #30733
    platform/ios, area-essentials, community ✨, area-essentials-permissions
  • [Android] Fix image race condition by removing overly restrictive IsLoading check #30731
  • [.NET10] Mark obsolete layout APIs as [Obsolete with error] #30730
  • [iOS] Support for bluetooth permission #30729
    platform/ios, area-essentials, community ✨, area-essentials-permissions
  • [Android] Fix Loaded event not triggering when navigating back to a previous page #30725
  • [iOS] ScrollView content offset RTL - fix #30724
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-scrollview

Merged

  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 30696 - [07/21/2025] Candidate #30711
    p/0, area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, test-flight, .NET 9 SR10

Updated

  • [.Net10][Proposal]Shell - TabActiveTapped event #30446
    proposal/open, platform/android, platform/ios, community ✨
  • Expose DispatcherExtensions so it could be used outside of Maui as well #30488
    p/0, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0-preview7
  • Fix Glide IllegalArgumentException for destroyed activities in image loading #29780
    .NET 9 SR10
  • July 21st, 2025 Candidate #30696
  • Implement iOS/macOS secondary ToolbarItems - Shell #30480
    proposal/open, platform/ios, p/0, community ✨, area-controls-toolbar, .NET 10.0-preview7
  • [.NET 10] Add layout performance logging #30130
    t/enhancement ☀️, p/0, perf/general, .NET 10.0-preview7
  • Source Generator for XAML #30442
  • [NET10.0][Windows] Add API to Enable/Disable Minimize and Maximize Buttons on Windows #29822
    platform/windows, p/0, community ✨, area-controls-window, .NET 10.0-preview7
  • [Android] Set FillViewport to true to MauiHorizontalScrollView #26904
    platform/android, p/0, community ✨, area-controls-scrollview, .NET 9 SR10
  • Fix for exception thrown when disconnecting page handlers in the Unloaded event while navigating on MacCatalyst and iOS #29410
    platform/macos, area-controls-shell, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 9 SR10
  • [housekeeping] Automated PR to fix formatting errors on net10.0 #30722
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure
